PromptsConfig.description:
Wording of the scoring prompt (models/prompts.py). The output format
and JSON constraints are fixed because the response parser depends on
them.

scoring_system.default:
You are a semantic relevance scoring engine for a focused web crawler.

Your job is to evaluate candidate links and assign:
- a relevance score (0 to 100)
- a relevance type
- optional semantic expansions

Return ONLY valid JSON.
No markdown.
No explanation outside JSON.
scoring_system.description: System prompt of the link-scoring LLM call.
scoring_system.title: Scoring System

scoring_rules.default:
RULES:
- Each candidate URL is independent
- Use strategy_context as soft bias only
- Score range: integer 0–100
- Assign exactly one relevance_type:
  direct | partial | irrelevant | ambiguous
- Generate 2–4 semantic expansions per link
- Expansions must be conceptual, not copied text
scoring_rules.description: RULES block of the scoring prompt.
scoring_rules.title: Scoring Rules

strategy_contexts.description: Wording that biases the scoring LLM, per scoring strategy.
strategy_contexts.title: Strategy Contexts

PromptsConfig.title: PromptsConfig

ScoringCascadeConfig.description:
The two-stage NLP -> LLM relevance cascade's tunable thresholds and
sampling fractions (report section 0.13, "Evaluation multi-etapes").

percentile_bucketing.description: Bucket links by per-node score percentile instead of the absolute thresholds.
percentile_bucketing.title: Percentile Bucketing

low_threshold.description: NLP similarity score below which a link is considered low-confidence.
low_threshold.title: Low Threshold

high_threshold.description: NLP similarity score above which a link is considered high-confidence.
high_threshold.title: High Threshold

high_score_llm_fraction.description: Fraction of the high-confidence bucket still sent to the LLM rather than trusted outright -- this is the cascade's cost-saving lever.
high_score_llm_fraction.title: High Score Llm Fraction

high_score_random_fraction.description: Of the LLM-bound slice of the high bucket, the fraction chosen at random rather than by top NLP rank (bias correction).
high_score_random_fraction.title: High Score Random Fraction

low_score_sample_fraction.description: Fraction of the low-confidence bucket kept anyway, for exploration, instead of dropped outright.
low_score_sample_fraction.title: Low Score Sample Fraction

default_priority_strategy.description: Priority strategy used when a blueprint doesn't specify one.
default_priority_strategy.title: Default Priority Strategy

low_percentile.description: Percentile below which a link falls in the low bucket.
low_percentile.title: Low Percentile

high_percentile.description: Percentile above which a link falls in the high bucket.
high_percentile.title: High Percentile

percentile_min_links.description: Fewer links than this on a page fall back to the absolute thresholds.
percentile_min_links.title: Percentile Min Links

max_llm_links_per_node.description: Hard cap on links sent to the LLM for one page.
max_llm_links_per_node.title: Max Llm Links Per Node

llm_batch_size.description: Links per LLM call; empty sends all of a page's links in one call.
llm_batch_size.title: Llm Batch Size
